query:
UPDATE jobs SET locked_at = now(), attempts = attempts + 1
           WHERE id = (
               SELECT id FROM jobs
               WHERE run_at <= now()
                 AND (locked_at IS NULL
                      OR locked_at < now() - make_interval(mins => $1))
               ORDER BY run_at
               FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
               LIMIT 1
           )
           RETURNING id, kind, payload, attempts
